item.title: Contratto di ricerca: AI-Driven Open Data Innovation for SMEs: data valorisation and technology transfer through Artificial Intelligence (Univ. CAMERINO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 13:00
Institution: Univ. CAMERINO, Camerino
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

The research aims to identify and overcome the main technological, organizational, and cognitive barriers that hinder SMEs from effectively using data and information resources to support their decision-making and innovation processes. Building on the experience gained through the European ODECO project, the research will develop methodologies and AI-based solutions, leveraging Generative Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques to facilitate access to, integration, and valorization of heterogeneous information sources, making knowledge more accessible even to users without advanced Data Science skills. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: COMPETITION FOR N.1 RESEARCH CONTRACT, GROUP 01/INFO-01 INFORMATICS AT “BIDSA” RESEARCH CENTER AT UNIVERSITÀ COMMERCIALE “LUIGI BOCCONI” DI MILANO (Univ. Bocconi MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2027-01-15 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

The work is related to a project in fine-grained complexity and algorithms. In particular, it aims to draw connections between diverse fine-grained complexity hypotheses, and to extend the theory with beyond-worse-case analysis. The selected candidate will be responsible for the following activities: • Conducting independent and collaborative research on topics related to the project's objectives. • Developing new algorithmic techniques and fine-grained reductions between various fundamental computational problems. • Contributing to scientific publications and present findings at international conferences.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: "AIMH 2.0 AI-based Management of Media, Textual, and Humanities Data 2.0" - Bando CR 010 2026 ISTI PI (CNR - Istituto di scienza e tecnologie dell'informazione "Alessandro Faedo")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 12:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto di scienza e tecnologie dell'informazione "Alessandro Faedo", Pisa
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

The research activity will address artificial intelligence and deep learning applied to visual analysis and pattern recognition, focusing on two main directions. The first is class-agnostic counting, leveraging multimodal AI to develop models capable of counting objects of arbitrary categories, unseen during training, from a few visual exemplars or textual descriptions. This aims to create flexible and generalizable counting systems for open-world scenarios. The second explores bio-inspired learning approaches, such as Hebbian learning, as an alternative to backpropagation, and the use of biological neuronal cultures as a computational substrate. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Physics-Informed Digital Twins for Breast-Cancer Invasiveness Scoring - 2026_CDR_DMAT_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-04 Fisica matematica

The research programme aims to develop physics-informed digital twins for the quantitative assessment of breast-cancer invasiveness. The activity will integrate mechanistic models of tumour growth and invasion with experimental data obtained from in vitro multicellular systems. Particular attention will be devoted to tumour–microenvironment interactions, including active wetting, tissue remodelling, adhesion, friction, traction and cell migration. The physical matematical models will be used to identify latent biomechanical parameters, such as surface tension, viscosity, active stresses, adhesion and friction properties.
